privacy: Local files only. Your document stays in this browser.
drop: Drop a Word document or template here to convert
invalid: Choose a readable DOCX, DOCM, DOTX, or DOTM file. The document may be damaged or use an unsupported feature.
protected: Encrypted documents and legacy Word files cannot be converted. Save an unencrypted DOCX copy and try again.
resource: This document needs more memory than this browser can provide. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The converter could not load. Check your connection and try again.
noText: This document has no extractable text. Scanned pages and images are not transcribed.
copyFailed: The text could not be copied. Select it in the output or download the Markdown file.
formatNote: Markdown preserves text and basic structure, not page layout. Headers, footers, notes, and comments appear in separate sections. Fields use their saved text; macros and external resources are not run or loaded.
omittedNote: Some content cannot be represented faithfully. Images, charts, equations, and shapes may use omission markers; merged or nested tables and tracked changes are simplified. Check the output against the original.
